title: Admit the Governance to Ontology Lifecycle Context Map

artifact_type.representation_note: The decision-record format remains a local bootstrap candidate. Authority comes from the exact user approval exercised through the separately admitted context-map-owner role.

selection.selection_source: Exact user instruction `approved` in the active task, following presentation of the complete CTX04 Context Map.
selection.rationale: Admit one explicit directional Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle relationship while preserving endpoint autonomy, exact upstream identity, downstream translation, non-authority transfer, and the absence of a reverse edge.

authority_basis.decision_separation: The Context Map owner admits map membership and directional relationship contracts only; this decision does not infer endpoint-context, language, global relationship-kind, migration, or implementation authority.

prerequisite_admissions.purpose: Governance and Ontology Lifecycle endpoint context-language pairs

planning_basis.preserved_direction: Governance upstream; Ontology Lifecycle downstream; reverse dependency forbidden unless separately authored and owner-selected.

materialization.rule: The immutable machine-canonical map candidate and its generated projection remain unchanged. This decision overlays admitted status on their exact identity, version, and SHA-256 digests.
materialization.relationship_scope: The relationship pattern is admitted only as the map-local classification of this one exact directional relationship. It does not create or admit a reusable global relationship-kind artifact.
materialization.authority_boundary: Governance publishes an exact immutable owner-decision envelope; Ontology Lifecycle may translate and record it locally without acquiring Governance meaning, ownership, admission, or enforcement authority.
materialization.endpoint_references: The admitted endpoint candidates remain immutable and retain empty context_map_refs. Any endpoint reference update requires separately authored successor epochs.

excluded_effects: No reverse Ontology-Lifecycle-to-Governance edge or feedback contract is selected or admitted.
No reusable global relationship-kind definition or artifact is admitted; the pattern remains local to this exact map relationship.
No endpoint context or Ubiquitous Language bytes are changed, and no context_map_refs are silently inferred.
No source governance ontology or Ontology Lifecycle business ontology receives admission through this map.
No payload schema, Anti-Corruption Layer adapter, transport, capability instance, DomainSpec source, system ontology, or implementation binding is admitted.
No migration planning or execution, destructive action, commit, push, publication, deployment, external effect, or stable release is authorized or performed.
successor_obligations: Author successor endpoint-context epochs before adding explicit context_map_refs; do not rewrite the admitted candidate bytes.
Author any reusable relationship-kind artifact and seek separate owner admission before using this map-local label as global authority.
Author the runtime payload schema and Anti-Corruption Layer adapter only through their own construction and conformance chain.
Prepare source-admission, lineage, migration, validation, and rollback artifacts before moving any source bytes.
claim_ceiling: This decision admits only the exact Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle Context Map and its one map-local directional relationship pattern. It does not admit a reusable global relationship kind, create a reverse dependency, mutate endpoint artifacts, admit either source ontology, authorize a runtime adapter, migration or implementation, commit, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
